would_authorize: ONE D2 behavioural SCREENING session: the eight frozen probes (c1..c4 x seeds 516448251, 614923639) from the four committed initializations, the rollout-rescoring diagnostic on each, stopping at preservation; the ranking and the one-or-none selection computed off-pod at $0. A replacement after a pre-science failure is a new one-use authorization netted against the same envelope.
would_not_authorize: the shared confirmation (a separate grant naming the advancing candidate)
retraining, regenerating or re-evaluating B or q2
any change to K, the seeds, the SESOI, the rule or the battery

arm_staging._basis: the D2 search's setup staged the 8,045,568,320-byte teacher within 5.85 min (logs/stages/stage-1/phase_d2/runs/d2_search_20261015_051722/closeout/outcome.json), so a pod pulls at least 22.9 MB/s; one 1,192,135,096-byte arm plus its identity check, x3.0 for the bound
arm_staging.replaces: D1's 22-minute on-pod rematerialization per arm: a D2 arm is a persisted search product, not a path to replay

previous_planning_figure.why_lower_now: the arms are staged from the relay (persisted and round-trip verified) instead of four 22-minute on-pod re-materializations

issuance_and_launch: 1. commit and push this tree; it is the executable commit
2. the maintainer writes the grant (template below) to logs/budget/approvals/autoinit_d2_screening_grant.json

3. issue: PYTHONPATH=src:scripts .venv/bin/python scripts/stages/stage-1/phase_d2/issue_d2_screening_authorization.py --grant <grant> --run-id d2_screening_<utc>  (quotes the live rate, derives and nets the ceiling, binds the contract hash)
4. commit the authorization alone; stage the bundle: scripts/stages/stage-1/phase_d1/stage_d1_bundle.py --experiment-id phase_d2 --session-commit <sha> --run-id <run>

5. dry run (all $0 gates, creates nothing), then the launch in a durable tmux session: scripts/stages/stage-1/phase_d2/autoinit_d2_screening_launch.py --scr <scr> --session-commit <sha> --bundle aad_autoinit_<sha8>.bundle --run-id <run>

failure_semantics.before_any_training: ordinary engineering: preserve, tear down, repair, a new authorization netted against the envelope (P12.1)
failure_semantics.after_training_began: every trained checkpoint is preserved off-pod and identity-verified while the pod runs; a replacement pod restores them (--restore-trained) and RESUMES each at evaluation -- never retrains a frozen unit; a complete valid probe is never re-run
failure_semantics.runtime_mismatch: a training runtime or attested evaluation protocol other than the shared rung's stops the session before it generates; the host admission redraws non-matching hosts first
failure_semantics.diagnostics: the token-id sidecar and the rescoring never block, alter or re-run a scored probe; a wrapper failure falls back to the plain generator

statistical_integrity.statistic: pooled seed-mean correct_overall delta vs B, C0's guardrail vetoes
statistical_integrity.selection: exactly one candidate advances, or none
statistical_integrity.tie_break: the experiment's frozen quality position, then state id
statistical_integrity.field: frozen by the experiment's own retention decision before any behavioural datum; its size is that experiment's preregistered choice
statistical_integrity.q2_screening_rows: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY. q2 advanced on these prompts and seeds, so its screening estimate is inflated by the winner's curse (screening +0.00825 vs B, confirmation -0.000392). Never a ranking comparator
statistical_integrity._not_eight_independent_architectures: the four candidates are near-siblings of one lineage; the paired seeds are the replicate, and eight probes are not eight independent tests
statistical_integrity._frozen: no seed is added, no SESOI moves and no candidate is re-screened because candidates land close together

grant_template.covers: ONE D2 screening session of the eight frozen probes; not the confirmation, not B/q2, not a promotion
